entities.summary: Hernando de Soto Polar is a Peruvian economist. He is known for his work on the informal economy and on the importance of business and property rights. He is the current president of the Institute for Liberty and Democracy (ILD), a think tank devoted to promoting economic development in developing countries located in Lima, Peru.
